name: Rapport-Jobava System
description: An aggressive Jobava-style queen's pawn opening that teaches fast development, pressure on the center, and tactical attacking ideas.

branches.title: Main Line: Nc3 and Bf4

moves.title: Start with d4
moves.explanation: Control the center and open the c1 bishop. d4 changes the central structure. Central pawn moves should either claim space, challenge an enemy pawn, or open a line for a piece. The Rapport-Jobava setup develops quickly with Nc3 and Bf4, then waits for a real target before attacking.

moves.title: Black develops
moves.explanation: Black controls e4 and d5. Nf6 develops a knight to f6. Developed pieces control central squares, help castling, and make future tactics possible without forcing anything too early.
